recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the applied clarification while preserving the current notConsumedItem backbone model and avoiding any modifier or cardinality change.
issue_request: FHIR-47247 asked whether the old NutritionIntake notConsumed flag should be marked isModifier=true. The Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification disposition said the reorganization removed the need for modifier treatment and requested a comment on NutritionIntake.nutritionItem clarifying use of the not-consumed element.
initial_application: Commit 05e646d74bb93a1c435d884747dc64da94898435 explicitly named FHIR-47247 and replaced the old notConsumed boolean/notConsumedReason shape with the current NutritionIntake.nutritionItem.notConsumedItem backbone. That applied the modeling change but left NutritionIntake.nutritionItem without the requested usage comment.
additional_context: FHIR-45063 required separating consumed and not-consumed NutritionIntake items, and FHIR-48727 later confirmed pulling not-consumed details into a backbone with reason, schedule, and amount. The 2024-10-28 OO HCP minutes record that moving notConsumed out of consumedItem made it no longer an isModifier candidate. NutritionIntake is active in the current build and assigned to OO in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Added an ElementDefinition.comment to source/nutritionintake/structuredefinition-NutritionIntake.xml for NutritionIntake.nutritionItem. The comment distinguishes consumedItem for nutrition that was consumed or administered from notConsumedItem for nutrition intended but refused, held, or otherwise not consumed.
source_changes: source/nutritionintake/structuredefinition-NutritionIntake.xml: added NutritionIntake.nutritionItem ElementDefinition.comment clarifying consumedItem versus notConsumedItem usage.
